title: write
description: Whole-file write — replaces the shell heredoc and the touch-then-edit dance. Creates `path` with `content` when it does not exist, replaces its whole content when it does. The bytes land exactly as given (no formatter), through the same write engine as edit: parse-verify, journal, atomic swap, undoable. Confirm gating follows edit's single-file rule: over 200 changed lines answers CONFIRM_REQUIRED, except under edit.confirm_mode = "token" where the write applies on the first call unless edit.force_confirm is set.

path.description: Workspace-relative file to create or replace. Parent directories are created.

content.description: The file's whole new content. An empty string writes an empty file.

expectedHash.description: read's contentHash for `path`. A mismatch with the file's current content answers STALE_ANCHOR carrying the fresh hash. Pass it whenever you replace a file you read.

dryRun.description: Run the full pipeline through verification and return the diff, touching nothing.

confirm.description: The confirmToken from a prior CONFIRM_REQUIRED answer for this exact call.

autoApply.description: Apply an already-authorized operation without an additional confirmation round trip. All path, syntax, staleness and journal checks remain active; dryRun still never applies. Token mode already applies without this flag unless force_confirm is set.
